steps.text: Boot resolves your device session without blocking guest play on account problems. Pause → Options → Account can save a five-digit PIN or sign in on another device. Accounts keep identity; progress stays with each room.

Your tab opens a WebSocket and authenticates with its device session in the first frame. The server resolves your player id, then checks the room and player cap. A newer connection for the same identity in this room takes over.
The server welcomes you and lists who is in the room. From here on it relays presence and messages between tabs.
The server runs the shared world and sends a complete replicated view, then accepted changes. Your client displays that room's state.
The server saves this room to disk when it changes. It pauses while empty and credits bounded production when someone returns. Signing in elsewhere does not copy this room's progress.
